title: Published alias map
description: Contract for v1/{dataset}/aliases.json: retired entity id -> the surviving entity id it resolves to. Emitted where entities have been merged (today only camps, from duplicate and program-variant listings folded into their base camp). Deliberately a bare map rather than a collection envelope, because the only sane consumer use is a direct lookup: resolve an id you were given, or 404. Both sides are bare slugs, never '{kind}:{slug}' refs, since the file is dataset-scoped. Ids are never reused, so an entry is permanent once published; a key must not also be a live entity id, which tools/validate_data.py enforces on the canonical side.
